title: Cascading Bandits with Noisy Observations: Algorithms and Regret Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2610.29381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a novel stochastic cascading bandit setup where probing an ordered shortlist of $K$ out of $L$ arms incurs position-dependent costs, and the learner observes only noisy feedback regarding each arm's true output. We identify a sub-class of noise models for which the optimal shortlist can be found by sorting arms according to a per-arm score: such a score exists for both selection and ordering when the channel has no false positives, and for ordering alone (but not selection) when measurements are costless; however in general neither selection nor ordering is separable once noise and cost are both present. For the case where both selection and ordering scores exist, we provide a UCB-based algorithm with $O((L-K)\log T)$ instance-dependent regret over a time horizon $T$, which matches an algorithm-agnostic lower bound (up to constant factors). translated_title: 带噪声观测的级联赌博机：算法与遗憾界
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的随机级联赌博机设置，其中探测从L个臂中选取K个臂构成的有序短列表会产生与位置相关的成本，而学习者只能观察到关于每个臂真实输出的噪声反馈。我们识别出一类噪声模型的子类，对于这些模型，可以通过依据每个臂的分数对臂进行排序来找到最优短列表：当信道不存在假阳性时，这样的分数对选择和排序同时存在；当测量无成本时，这样的分数仅对排序存在（但对选择不存在）；然而在一般情况下，一旦噪声和成本同时存在，选择和排序都无法分离。在选择和排序分数都存在的情形下，我们提出了一种基于UCB的算法，在时间范围T上具有O((L-K) log T)的实例相关遗憾，该遗憾与算法无关的下界相匹配（在常数因子内）。对于分数不存在的更具挑战性的场景，我们开发了一种新算法……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种探测成本与位置相关且反馈含噪声的随机级联赌博机模型，刻画了最优短列表可通过按每臂分数排序求得的条件，并给出了实例相关遗憾匹配理论下界的UCB算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stochastic cascading bandit model with position-dependent probing costs and noisy feedback, characterizes when the optimal shortlist can be obtained by sorting per-arm scores, and provides a UCB-based algorithm whose instance-dependent regret matches the algorithm-agnostic lower bound.
